scope: Offline research prototypes for clot endpoint candidates; independent new implementation, not AL4A port or a validated clinical assay

sources.title: Siemens Healthineers: Sysmex CS Systems Sample Result Evaluation Clotting Assays, T05012.002
sources.location: Percentage Detection Method – Measurement Principle for Clotting Assays, slide 2-8
sources.supports: The optical baseline and final endpoint define signal change; a selected percentage, often 50%, supplies a method-specific clotting point. Mask and reading windows matter.
sources.implementation_choices: Caller-provided complete curve, explicit optical direction and reagent-relative seconds; arithmetic mean of configured first/last point windows, configured search window and linear crossing interpolation. These are our numerical choices, not vendor reproduction.

sources.title: Diagnostic Grifols, S.A.: QNext Instructions for Use
sources.hosting_note: Mirror of manufacturer-authored primary manual; attribution and manufacturer identity checked in PDF
sources.supports: Maximum Rate selects the first-derivative peak time. PT/APTT variants include stabilization and/or filtering protections.
sources.implementation_choices: Our odd-window local linear regression estimates slope on nonuniform time samples; select an interior positive directed peak at sample resolution, reject obvious ambiguity and unstable reference windows. No claim to implement vendor PT/APTT protections.

sources.title: Clarification of fibrin generation and degradation reaction processes of clot-fibrinolysis waveform in hemorrhagic disorders
sources.supports: Distinguishes the percentage crossing and derivative peak measurements; observed proximity does not establish universal identity or transfer to SN100.

business_boundary.input: Synthetic or anonymized finite optical samples, strictly increasing nonnegative reagent-relative seconds, explicit rising/falling direction, complete acquisition including baseline and terminal plateau
business_boundary.output: Separate percentage and maximum-derivative candidate times, method details, parameters, raw inputs and explicit failures; no result averaging or silent fallback
business_boundary.defaults: All amplitude, stability, window and ambiguity defaults are engineering trial settings, not clinical cutoffs; must be confirmed on SN100 raw curves

next_validation: Confirm optical signal meaning, direction, units, sample period, reagent-addition zero and acquisition mask from SN100
Obtain anonymized normal/delayed/low-amplitude/no-clot/noisy/biphasic/incomplete traces and independent reference clot times
Freeze per-assay preprocessing, windows, stability/ambiguity and minimum response settings before evaluation
Compare candidate time error, invalid-result rate, repeats, noise/filter sensitivity, runtime/resource use and RK behavior; do not tune tolerance on evaluation data
